title: Chat with a Local AI in Your Terminal (Ollama)
description:
Chat with a coding AI that runs on your own machine. 💬

✅ Start a chat with ollama run
✅ Ask a question and get an answer
✅ Leave the chat with /bye

Day 2 of Local AI Coding. Next up: Day 3, Call Your Local Model with an API Request.
Follow for a new short every day and build your local AI setup.

#shorts #ollama #localai #ai #coding #programming #aitools #tutorial
comment: Terminal or editor chat: which would you use first? Tell me in a word! Extra tip: ollama run keeps the chat going, so follow-up questions remember what you asked before.
